basic_info.description:
Welcome! We have a 3 BR / 1.5 BA to rent in the prime neighborhood of Russian Hill. The apartment is the top unit in a three-unit classic Edwardian building. Discover the epitome of urban living in the prestigious Russian Hill neighborhood of San Francisco, California. Nestled in a prime location, this apartment offers stunning views and an unparalleled blend of modern comforts and timeless elegance. 

Available to rent July 1 (inquire about flexibility). You can visit the unit anytime; please call or text to schedule a time. 

 Apartment Features:

Soaring coved ceilings, classic Italian molding, and high end carpeting / wood flooring throughout

Stunning views of Coit Tower, Marin, Alcatraz, Berkeley Hills, and more from two bedrooms

Split bathroom (Italian flat style) with newly remodeled shower, Duravit tub, travertine tile, and Grohe fixtures

Chef-friendly kitchen offers new LG stove/oven, new Bosch dishwasher, and stainless steel appliances

Oversized windows and Victorian wainscotting all around the house

Formal dining room with original built-in liquor cabinet with dental moulding

Bonus "sun room" at back of unit with utility sink and dedicated in-unit laundry

A shared backyard with blooming camellia and ample space for fun and play

1,450 sq ft living space plus ~300 sq ft space for storage in basement 

Luxurious Smith & Noble window blinds

Grand entryway with extra wide staircase and gated entrance

Close to public transit

Walk score of 98

Lots of cafes, restaurants, nightlife, parks and iconic landmarks within walking distance

Famous Lombard street is two blocks away

Neighborhood Highlights:

Explore the charming streets of Russian Hill, known for its iconic cable cars and breathtaking views

Walk to the vibrant dining and shopping scene of Ghirardelli Square and Fisherman's Wharf

Easy access to North Beach, Chinatown, and the Financial District

Enjoy nearby Washington Square and green spaces, perfect for leisurely strolls or picnics

Convenient Transit:

Quick access to public transportation, including buses and cable cars.

Close proximity to major tech companies and downtown San Francisco.

Don't miss the opportunity to call this exquisite Russian Hill apartment your new home! Immerse yourself in the quintessential San Francisco experience. Contact us today to schedule a tour and secure your slice of city paradise.

Welcome to a lifestyle of sophistication and convenience at the heart of San Francisco's Russian Hill! 

Terms:

Positive credit history

One year lease

Positive rental history

Must be fully employed

Pets allowed (up to two dogs ok) for additional fee, breed limitations and deposit of $300

Applicant must provide:

Completed application 

Copy of current pay stub

Copy of photo ID

Credit report

Move-in cost includes first month rent, last month rent and a security deposit 

Fee of $150 per month for water and garbage

Security deposit payment can be spread out over multiple months
